name: Eightfold AI
tagline: Eightfold AI is an enterprise talent platform that uses deep learning to match candidates to roles, identify employees ready for internal mobility, and predict workforce needs — drawing on a database of over 1.5 billion career trajectories. Its AI removes keyword-matching bias by evaluating skills and potential rather than job titles and degrees. Large enterprises and government agencies use Eightfold to make faster, more equitable hiring and retention decisions.
